canonicalGuidance: Do not hand-write /v4/data/resources/.../<type> paths in feature code. Keep PascalCase model names separate from exact stored slugs. Emitted linkTypes[].targetObjectType, runtime target_type, paths, and governed v4 fields use slugs. Resolve same-manifest name shorthand through its declared slug, use the shared platform SDK, useResources, or client.resources for routes, and never re-derive or rename historical stored slugs.
